expected: The round's evidence packet belongs in the repository so an external officer can verify it from a fresh clone
actual: It does live in the repository - but on the product branch, where the repository's own governed write-set gate refuses it. The packet is therefore being moved to a dedicated evidence branch and the product branch keeps only the product change
why_it_matters: The round caused a red check on its own PR; the fix is to respect the repository's declared design rather than to widen the gate to admit a round's receipts

expected: The R6 work order names docs/install/README.md and docs/USER_GUIDE.md
actual: The declared stage-c write set includes docs/install/** but omits docs/USER_GUIDE.md, while the stage-b arm includes it
why_it_matters: An allowance change is required for a file the work order names; the workflow's own convention is a named amendment reviewed in the same PR

expected: The mandated checker should be the lane's default arm
actual: The lane's default (rank 1) arm is the writer's own model; the mandated checker is rank 2. This is BY OWNER ORDER, not a defect (registry SOD006-C3 OWNER_ORDERED_IN_FORCE)
why_it_matters: Following the pool would produce a verdict from the weights that wrote the change, i.e. no separation of duties
disposition: WORKED-AROUND-BY-PINNING-THE-ARM; registry left untouched by design

expected: A checker verdict should cover the served artefacts too
actual: The previous checker's own NOT_RUNs were sandbox limits (network refused, no temporary directory), not subject properties
why_it_matters: Accepting them as permanent bounds would leave the accepted evidence weaker than the round could make it

expected: The guard's mutation cases should prove it would have caught the historical defect
actual: Mutation cases prove the checks CAN fail; only running the guard against the pre-repair tree proves it WOULD have failed
why_it_matters: Falsifiability aimed at synthetic mutations alone is the weaker claim

expected: The round's own counts for the full suite should be comparable with the R6 report's CI counts
actual: Local: 621 passed / 20 skipped / 62 subtests. Report CI: 624 OK / 6 skipped
why_it_matters: Different environments and skip sets; presenting one as the other is a false provenance claim in the flattering direction
